sections.title: Morning Shift (06:35 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Route Alpha commenced. Conducted patrol along Queen Street to maintain a visible security presence.
Conducted an inspection of Durham Street for any vagrants occupying public property. No persons of concern were located.
Arrived at the intersection of Queen Street and Wyndham Street. Area inspected and found clear of any issues.
Arrived at the intersection of Queen Street and Shortland Street. Welfare checks conducted on businesses operating within the vicinity. All clear.
Completed a walkthrough of Pocket Park. No vagrants or issues identified.
Conducted welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. All clear.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Completed a full inspection of the area, followed by welfare checks along Rutland Street and Tyler Street. No issues identified.
Stationed at TK Square to maintain a visible security presence while remaining available for response calls.
Departed standby position and resumed patrol duties.
Conducted welfare check at the Albert Street Bus Terminal. Area clear. Businesses within the vicinity remained closed.
Arrived at the intersection of Customs Street and Albert Street. Area inspected with no issues identified.
Conducted welfare checks at Albert Mart and Discount Dairy. All clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Swanson Street and Albert Street. No issues observed.
Conducted patrol through Federal Square and the surrounding Cathedral precinct. No concerns identified.
Arrived at the intersection of Albert Street and Wyndham Street. Welfare checks conducted at Good To Go Supermarket and Hollywood Café. All clear.
Conducted welfare checks at Little Albert's Café, Formery, Sky Mart Convenience Store, and The People's Barista. No issues identified.

Arrived at the top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks conducted on businesses throughout the area. All clear. Remained on standby while maintaining a visible security presence and awaiting response calls.
Departed standby position and resumed patrol duties.
Conducted welfare checks at AA Insurance, City Convenience Store, and Mr Barber Shop. All clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Albert Street and Wellesley Street. No issues observed.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Completed a full sweep of the area to ensure no issues were present. Welfare checks conducted at Jack's Fried Chicken and the Aotea Centre. All clear.
Maintained a visible security presence while remaining on standby for response calls.
Alpha Route concluded. Delta Route commenced.
Conducted welfare checks at Auckland Town Hall, Queens Food Court, and businesses along Upper Queen Street. All clear.
Arrived at the top of Mayoral Drive. Area inspected for any concerns. None identified.
Conducted a walkthrough along Wakefield Street and completed welfare checks on businesses within the area. All clear.
Completed a walkthrough around Auckland Library. Premises remained closed. No vagrants or rough sleepers were present.
Arrived at the intersection of Lorne Street and Wellesley Street. Welfare checks conducted along Lorne Street and the surrounding water fountain area. All clear.
Arrived at the intersection of Lorne Street and High Street. No issues identified. Conducted patrol along High Street while completing welfare checks on businesses within the area.
Completed a walkthrough of Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall. No issues observed.
Arrived at Chancery Square. Completed a full sweep of the vicinity with no issues identified. Remained on standby for response calls while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed standby position. No incidents or noteworthy activity had occurred during the shift to this point. Returned to Headquarters for the scheduled morning interval and restroom break.
Arrived at Headquarters and remained available for response calls.
Morning interval completed. Patrol duties resumed.
Conducted welfare check at Starbucks. All clear. Conducted patrol along Queen Street to maintain a visible security presence while completing welfare checks.
Arrived at Wilson Parking. Welfare checks conducted on businesses within the location. All clear.

Arrived at the lower end of Fort Street. Welfare checks conducted on businesses and premises within the area. All clear. Remained on standby for response calls while maintaining a visible security presence.
Departed standby position and resumed patrol duties.
Conducted welfare checks at 77 Convenience Store and The Coffee Club. All clear.
Arrived at Kiwibank. Area inspected for any concerns. No issues identified.
Conducted welfare check within Queens Arcade. All clear.
Conducted welfare check at McDonald's Britomart. All clear.

Response call from Hotel Debrett, High Street. Reported a street vagrant encampment inside one of their restrooms. POI is smoking inside the restroom and the staff has requested assistance of removal asap.

Arrived at response location, POI was still inside the bathroom. We managed to successfully get the POI to leave the restroom without any damages or escalation. Remained on standby for response calls while maintaining a visible security presence.
Delta Route concluded. Charlie Route commenced.
Arrived at check in Chancery Square, full sweep completed within the vicinity. Quick standby to ensure security presence. Area inspected with no concerns identified.

Response call from McDonald's Queen Street, reported the same male POI who walks in demanding an order that he didn't purchase. He's causing a disturbance for customers and staff, verbally accusing them of not making his food.
Arrived at response location, POI had already disappeared from the site. Will be standing by to show our presence. (Incident has been posted to Auror.)
Conducted welfare checks at Woolworths and Chemist Warehouse. All clear. Stopped in to grab some drinks.
Response call from McDonald's Queen Street, reported the same POI, he has now returned.
Arrived at response location, POI is now gone again. Continuing our standby for further issues.
Returned to Headquarters and commenced lunch break while preparing for handover to the afternoon shift.
Equipment handover: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (15:00 – 21:00)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Received a response call from Unichem Pharmacy on Queen Street regarding a vagrant female in the store; manager believes she's hiding an item but she refuses to search her pockets.

Arrived at Unichem Pharmacy and the vagrant female still inside the store. We asked her to search her pockets; she complied and checked her pockets, no item found. Then the vagrant female paid for some items and left the store peacefully.
Standby in front of Unichem Pharmacy to show our presence.
Continuing our patrols down Queen and doing our welfare along the way.
Welfare check on Victoria St, top High Street.
Doing full sweep all around Freyberg area and Chancery Square, all clear, no issues.
Standby Freyberg Square for any near calls and showing our presence.
Patrol through O'Connell Street, bottom of High St, Fort St, White Lady, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Gore St, Auckland Harbour Suites, all clear, no issues. Beta complete.

Received a call from Bop Mart reporting a female took some items from them before without paying and she appears again inside their store; they asked her to pay for the items she took before but she refused.
Arrived at Bop Mart store; the female left the store and is making her way down the Commercial Bay area (photo on file).
Response to Glassons store call reporting two school girls were inside the store; they believe they took some stuff with them and they headed up Queen Street (photo on file).

Received a call from Queen Street McDonald's reporting a missing kid inside the store crying for their parents. Follow-up call advised the kid is now safe; the parents found them and they have left the store.
Patrolling upper Queen Street and doing our welfare along the way.
Welfare check on Aotea Square, Mayoral Drive, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Albert Mart Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Customs St, Custom Mart Convenience Store, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Fort Lane, Fort St Jo & Joe, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on High St, High Street Supermarket, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check on Chancery Square, Freyburg area, Upper High Street, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Lorne St, Auckland Library, all clear, no issues. Delta Route complete.
Received a call from Ippondo regarding a group of vagrants smoking weed in front of their store.
Arrived at Ippondo and the group of vagrants have been moving along.
We arrived at Ippondo and the POI had left before we arrived. Standing by for security presence.
Received a call from Elliott Stables about a female vagrant making people feel uncomfortable.
We arrived and she was going through bins and asking for food (photo provided). We approached her and asked her to vacate the vicinity. Standing by for security presence.
Queen St McDonald's, 77 Convenience Store, Localito, and Timezone all clear. Standing by due to large foot traffic.
Male is being aggressive towards council wardens.

Male was being aggressive towards the Council compliance team because they were recording. He got triggered by that and we were able to de-escalate the situation and get him to move (photo provided). Standing by for security presence.
Standing by at office and awaiting shift changeover and having break.
2nd Manager arrived and sent him up.
Standing by at the office to charge the Ops phone.

sections.title: Night Shift (23:00 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Welfare check McDonald's Queens, 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square, commencing sweep in the area due to a lot of footwork in the area.
Full sweep Aotea Square, no issues to report. Patrolling down to Bar101.
Arrived at Bar101, maintaining presence due to active footwork in the area.
Removed alcohol from male individual drinking in public.
Welfare check Bar101, all clear, no issues to report. Heading back to office to commence floor checks.
Arrived at Headquarters, commencing floor checks.
Arrived at Bar101, standing by showing presence.
Welfare check Bar101, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Queen Street.
Encountered by member of the public asking for directions to Bar101, guided individual to safe passage. Continuing patrols.
Full sweep lower Queen Street, welfare check 77 Convenience Store, all clear, no issues. Arriving at Britomart, commencing sweep and maintaining presence.
Welfare check McDonald's Britomart, all clear, no issues.
Keeping a close eye on a group of individuals that may be suspected of causing a brawl.
Full sweep Britomart and welfare checks, all clear. Continuing patrols.
Welfare check Kemuri and Reign n Pour, all clear, no issues to report.
Arrived at Quay Street, commencing welfare checks in the area.
Full sweep Quay Street, welfare checks on guards and businesses open within the area, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up Britomart to Fort Lane.
Welfare check Kemuri guard and business, all clear.
Welfare check Britomart McDonald's, all clear, no issues.
Welfare check Q Customs Mart, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Fort Lane.
Welfare check Sapphire Night Club, all clear, no issues to report.
Welfare check Shortland St and mart, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up High Street.
Welfare check Vulcan Lane, all clear.
Arrived at Freyburg Pl, commencing sweep.
Full sweep Freyburg Place, all clear, no issues to report.
High Street all clear, no issues to report. Patrolling up Lorne St.
Welfare check Lorne St staircase and Red Radisson, all clear, no issues. Patrolling down Queen Street to Bar101.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen Street, all clear, no issues to report. Heading to Bar101 for safe closing.
Arrived at Bar101, maintaining presence till closing and minimizing risk.
Bar101 all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Darby St / Elliott St, all clear, no further issues. Patrolling up Victoria Street.
Sweep Victoria Street West, welfare check 77 Convenience Store, no further issues.
Full sweep Federal St, check in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, Liston House, all clear, no issues.
Wyndham St all clear, no issues. Heading down Queen Street to Britomart.
Welfare check Shakes, all clear, no issues to report. Continuing patrols.
Welfare check Britomart Maccas / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Completed check Fort St / Wilson Carpark, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up High Street to Freyburg for full sweep.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Square, all clear, no issues.
Sweeped corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, all clear, no issues. Patrolling up to Aotea Square.
Full sweep Aotea Square, all clear, no issues to report, no footwork in the area. Heading down Queen Street to welfare check.
Welfare check Queen Street McDonald's, all clear, no issues to report. Heading to HQ to commence 30 minute break and wait till morning shift handover.
Arrived at Headquarters, commencing break and responding to any calls that occur.
Night shift concluded, handing over to morning shift.
Equipment handover: 4 x Keys, 3 x Vest, 2 x Bodycam, 1 x Ops Phone.
